source:
# Port of lib/pubid/ieee/nesc/parser.rb — National Electrical Safety
# Code designations: C2-year, year-first, name-first and Draft forms
# with (R) marks, editions and variants. Consumed by the ieee grammar
# via `use nesc`.
#
# Edition-2 notes: the year body (4digit — a bounded repetition of a
# ref) inlines at every capture site, since a capture wrapping a
# repetition ref expands to node lists inside the capture while the
# inlined body binds as one scalar string. The month / edition /
# variant captures stay on their rules — pure literal alternations
# bind as spans — and the (R)/NESC abbreviation marks capture their
# literal tokens directly.

grammar PubidNesc version "0.1.0" edition 2 {
  digit = %x30-39
  space = " "
  comma = ","
  dash = "-"
  dot = "."
  slash = "/"

  c2_code = "C2" as code
  nesc_full_name = "National Electrical Safety Code" / "National Electric Safety Code"
  nesc_abbr = "NESC"
  nesc_name = nesc_full_name / nesc_abbr
  registered = "(R)"
  edition = {
    (
        "Premier Edition"
      / "Second Edition"
      / "Third Edition"
      / "Fourth Edition"
      / "Fifth Edition"
      / "Sixth Edition"
      / "Seventh Edition"
      / "Eighth Edition"
      / "Ninth Edition"
      / "Tenth Edition"
      / "First Edition"
    ) as edition
  }
  variant = {
    ("Handbook" / "Redline") as variant
  }
  month = {
    (
        "January"
      / "February"
      / "March"
      / "April"
      / "May"
      / "June"
      / "July"
      / "August"
      / "September"
      / "October"
      / "November"
      / "December"
    ) as month
  }

  c2_standard = {
    (c2_code) (dash) ((4digit)) as year [([comma] space)] nesc_full_name
    [registered]
    [(space "(" (nesc_abbr) [(registered)] ")")]
  }
  year_first = {
    ((4digit)) as year space
    (
      ((nesc_full_name)) as full_name [(registered) as name_registered]
        [(space "(" (nesc_abbr) as paren_abbr [(registered) as paren_registered] ")")]
      / ((nesc_abbr)) as abbr [(registered) as abbr_registered]
    )
    [(space (variant))]
    [((comma space edition))]
  }
  name_first = {
    ((nesc_full_name [registered])) (comma space) c2_code (dash)
    ((4digit)) as year
    [((space "-" space (variant)))]
  }
  draft_nesc = {
    ("Draft") as nesc_draft_marker space nesc_name [registered] (comma space) (month) space
    ((4digit)) as year
  }
  # Preprint is a draft STAGE of the C2 code (NESC terminology for its
  # pre-edition drafts), not a variant: dotted is the canonical spelling
  # (C2.2012.Preprint); dash (C2-2012-Preprint) and the catalogue's
  # slash tail (C2-2002/Preprint) are aliases. The verbose
  # "Preprint Proposal(s) for the YYYY Edition of ..." forms cite the same
  # draft by its target edition year.
  c2_preprint = {
    c2_code
    (
      (dot ((4digit)) as year dot)
      / (dash ((4digit)) as year dash)
      / (dash ((4digit)) as year slash)
    )
    (("Preprint")) as preprint
  }
  preprint_proposal = {
    (("Preprint")) as preprint space ("Proposals" / "Proposal") space "for" space
    "the" space ((4digit)) as year space "Edition" space "of" space "the" space
    nesc_full_name
    [(space "(" (nesc_abbr) [registered] ")")]
  }
  nesc_identifier = draft_nesc / preprint_proposal / name_first / c2_preprint / c2_standard / year_first

  entry nesc_identifier: nesc_identifier

  bindings nesc_identifier {
    code -> code (string)
    year -> year (string)
    full_name -> full_name (string)
    name_registered -> name_registered (string)
    paren_abbr -> paren_abbr (string)
    paren_registered -> paren_registered (string)
    abbr -> abbr (string)
    abbr_registered -> abbr_registered (string)
    variant -> variant (string)
    edition -> edition (string)
    month -> month (string)
    preprint -> preprint (string)
  }

  test {
    accept "C2-2023 National Electrical Safety Code"
    accept "2023 NESC"
    accept "National Electrical Safety Code, C2-2017"
    accept "Draft NESC, January 2016"
    accept "C2.2012.Preprint"
    accept "C2-2012-Preprint"
    accept "C2-2002/Preprint"
    accept "Preprint Proposal for the 2017 Edition of the National Electrical Safety Code"
    accept "Preprint Proposals for the 2022 Edition of the National Electrical Safety Code (NESC(R))"
    reject "nonsense"
  }
}
